main_text.l: nam etsi emancipati pro extraneis nu-
lieni & extranei sunt: quippe cum san-
de reb. in hac Ceruidij Scævolæ dispu-
tatione agatur, videamus. Id autem, si rem
eos instituendi ratione, qui, si post testa-
toris mortem sui nascantur, præteriti te-
stamentum rumpat. Secundo eos, qui, si
institutione ita tractat, ut principio C.
Aquilij Galli, Iuriscōsulti Ro. viri pr-
ætorij & inter ætatis suæ Iurisconsultos fa-
cile principis, formulam ad eam rem perti-
non fuisse disputet: tertio, quibus ea in
sit, exponat: postremo, alteram ab sese

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "quere" (printed "q uere") is uncertain, and "dcinde" is probably a misprint for "deinde", so it is left as "deinde" with no mark. "usquequaq;" and "naturaleq;" follow the printed q; abbreviation. Long s is normalised to plain s throughout. A small mark right of "subiun-gat" is a stray speck, not a note. Running head changed to GALLUS per the capitals rule.
